offering_description.value: Cultivates, manufactures and sells branded cannabis products including flower, vape cartridges, edibles and concentrates. Sells to consumers through its own Rise and Rise Dispensary retail stores and to other licensed dispensaries wholesale, in US states where cannabis is legal.

primary_products.value: cannabis flower; vaporizer cartridges; edibles; concentrates; topicals and other cannabis products

customer_segment.value: B2C: adult-use and medical cannabis consumers and patients buying at company dispensaries; B2B: third-party licensed cannabis dispensaries buying wholesale

revenue_model.value: product sales: cannabis products sold at retail dispensaries and wholesale to licensed retailers

value_chain_position.value: OEM / manufacturer: grows cannabis and manufactures branded products, sold wholesale to licensed dispensaries; brand owner: owns consumer cannabis brands sold in own and third-party stores; retailer: operates licensed dispensaries selling directly to consumers and patients

geography_served.value: US regional: Licensed states including Illinois, Pennsylvania, Massachusetts, New Jersey, Ohio, Florida, Nevada, New York, Maryland and others

specialization.value: related lines: cannabis cultivation, branded product manufacturing and retail dispensaries

distribution_channels.value: own locations: company-owned Rise and Rise Dispensary retail stores; distributors / dealers: wholesale to third-party licensed dispensaries

regulatory_exposure.value: high: State cannabis licensing for cultivation, manufacturing and retail, remains illegal federally under the Controlled Substances Act
